On behalf of our client, Global Skilled Employment we are looking for skilled candidates for Senior Dairy Cattle Stockperson that will join the production team of a dairy in Gunbower, VIC 3566.

•	Plan all aspects of milk production process including management and coordination of milking shed routines.

•	Assisting with and/or performing irrigation works.
